When you set up your stall, you must select one member of your crew to be your Salesperson. Choose a character from the panel in the bottom left.
You will attract a certain number of customers with each shift depending on city size, your Salesperson's Speech stat, time of day, and other factors.

Added an Urgent Engine Repair feature. Now you can repair your truck's engine even if you are not in a city.

notes.title: Dustland Delivery: Sheol Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello, Dustlanders!

The Sheol DLC is out now! As a launch day treat, the DLC will be 10% off for the next 7 days! Don't miss out on this deal!
[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3559340/Dustland_Delivery_Sheol/]DLC Store Page[/url][/h3]

[h3]DLC Gameplay Preview[/h3]
While some of you Dustlanders may already know the basic gist of the new DLC, this post will delve a little deeper into the unique mechanics of the Sheol map.

[olist]
[*][b]Delve Into the Underground[/b]
In the Sheol DLC, you can use subway stations scattered across the map to enter the Underground, a vast network of tunnels, caverns, and subterranean cities.
[b]Surface[/b]: The last vestiges of civilization have fallen. Danger lurks around every corner.
[b]Underground[/b]: A few hardscrabble cities hold on, providing rest and respite for your crew.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/4654f9bab6dbffe66922b441157d230a682106fd.png[/img]
[*][b]New Terrain: Volcanoes & Glaciers[/b]
The new map adds two new biomes with extreme effects on your engine temp and horsepower. It'll take a master driver and a decked-out truck to pass through these areas unscathed.
[b]Surface Volcanoes & Glaciers:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/f482f1b348e26714bbbbeb5ea13f7b1a788b9f6b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/c585aeb7d3b070dff020e379efaa1be27157b2c9.png[/img]
[b]Underground Volcanoes & Glaciers:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/6d585764cbffba55b51daec1407ab92288b6eef3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/5a250c1748079b913b5da09bf3469cdaa26177be.png[/img]
[*][b]New Gameplay: Ruin Exploration[/b]
In every corner of the Underground, you'll find Ruins hiding both danger and opportunity. Dispatch a team of truckers to uncover secrets, battle new enemies, and reap the rewards!

[b]Ruin Entrance[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/6d80b85f4e9b6bf8d3d0f412bc6882d912acf36c.png[/img]
[b]Expedition Prep[/b]
Before entering a Ruin, you can pick which truckers to dispatch and assign supplies from your truck's inventory.
Each trucker has a limit on how much they can carry, so you'll need to carefully consider what to bring along.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/3b3e5694ac98aa7eb2b9f445783bd71e1ba59a1f.png[/img]
[b]Ruin Exploration[/b]
Use AP to explore the Ruin. With limited visibility, you'll uncover more of the map as you explore. You can split into small teams to cover more ground, or concentrate your forces to overcome a powerful enemy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/f4db3ee10a24c38c3ea591c93fa513be43ada893.png[/img]
[b]Ruin Combat[/b]
While exploring a Ruin, your crew may encounter enemies, entering into a new turn-based combat mode.
[olist]
[*]Entering into an unexplored tile may lead to you getting ambushed, allowing the enemy to act first.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/d22a97678190a325b46b4c3bb9bd413a05584169.png[/img]
With the right skills, on the other hand, you could be the one getting the drop on them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/eaf071b2467df05cb3d0834f62b24adbdc5e5968.png[/img]
[*][b]Combat Rules[/b]
During Ruin combat, you control each of your truckers individually. Each of them has their own AP, HP, and Attack, determined by their attributes. Your truckers will have multiple actions they can take, all of which cost AP.
[b]Common Actions[/b]
[list]
[*]Move: Spend AP to close in on an enemy or get some distance.
[*]Light/Heavy Attack:If a trucker is in close range, they can spend AP to melee attack an enemy.
Light Attacks cost 1 AP. Heavy Attacks cost all of a trucker's AP, dealing more damage the more AP spent.
[*]Shoot: A trucker with a gun can spend AP to shoot an enemy from a distance. Every shot counts in the Ruins; unlike regular battles, your truckers will need to carry their Ammo on their person.
[*]Throw: Truckers equipped with a Projectile can throw it, dealing damage to all enemies in a single space.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/056047b1af8a6a9cde24d9cabd30d4f3af59404c.png[/img]
[/list][b]Enemy Behavior[/b]
Once you've ended your turn, your enemies will get a chance to act. You'll encounter all sorts of enemies in the Ruins, each with their own tactics. Melee enemies will try to close in on you as fast as possible, whereas ranged ones will be happy to snipe at you from a distance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/657f904e0b3b4d423f172511d6d4b6e2c08fb771.png[/img]
[b]Victory and Death[/b]
Defeat all enemies to win the battle and divvy up the loot!
But don't get reckless: if a trucker's HP drops to 0, they're dead for good!
If all members of a team are dropped to 0 HP, you'll lose the battle, the team, and everything they were carrying.
For your whole crew to come out alive, you'll need to think about resource allocation, positioning, and much more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/275c4d7dbda0ac75e12211fd06fe08fbfb6f1f15.png[/img][/olist][/olist]
Are you ready to step into the cursed land of Sheol? Untold stories, unknown challenges, and unclaimed riches await!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3559340/Dustland_Delivery_Sheol/

notes.title: Dustland Delivery Free DLC Launch
notes.content:
Hello, Dustlanders!
Free DLC for Dustland Delivery is now available! After installing the DLC, you'll be able to build roads to ease your journey through the Dustlands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/a794e2cd7c5d4ab6a56b6b8355704c5ee9567053.jpg[/img]
[h2]How to Install[/h2]
1. Open your Steam library.
2. Select Dustland Delivery and click the Store Page.
3. Select the [b]Road Builder DLC[/b] from the Store or search [i]Dustland Delivery: Road Builder[/i] on Steam.
4. Click the Install button on the receipt page.

[h2]How to Build Roads[/h2]
After installing the DLC, you'll be able to build roads on the Haggard Plains and Twilight Valley maps.
Read on for details on how to build roads.
Road Builder buildings will appear on the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/c68c99ce954d72516a3ef9e93ed2d49972df7572.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/bd8aa03cd9e3fed19e4b9ab45ba7184f9d84b4ba.png[/img]
At these pre-Fall structures, staffed by robots, you can spend Clout to unlock the ability to build roads.
(Tip: Completing bounty missions issued at the Bar is the fastest way to gain Clout.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/c6195121b7e2c65a2dcf66a1ee004ddcd003c7a1.png[/img]
Once the ability has been unlocked, you can spend Clout to plot out the route of your road.
Select any two cities to plot a road between them. The default name of the road is taken from the first letter of each city's name; click the road name to rename it.
Roads are mainly built using three materials: Building Materials, Wood, and Ore. Building roads over rivers or swamps will also require Rubber; in return, you will be able to set up camp in swamp or river areas when the road is complete. Passing over more complex terrain will cost more Clout and resources.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/e9c8c7d820f6c865d7f65d4c26aa95821282d7c1.png[/img]
Once you confirm your road plan, construction sites will appear along the road.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/ca907eaa944687373c101be2581a3c0f5dfe995c.png[/img]
Nodes will also appear at various points along your road plan. These can be used to connect your road to other roads.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/f9cf13252acd057cc3856641ee582f68de9b44aa.png[/img]
Transport supplies to construction sites to deliver them. Once a construction site has all the supplies it needs, it will begin construction.
You can deliver supplies in multiple batches. Construction will progress depending on the item with the largest shortfall.
Once all supplies have been delivered, construction on that segment of road will begin.
(Note: If a segment of road has been built, you can drive on it even if the rest of the road isn't complete. This will allow you to access construction sites located within mountains.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/13a8f47a95558518a5634d2cd38766417d5fe000.png[/img]
Road segments under construction will be displayed in a translucent red color. Each construction site shows the construction progress of that road segment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/c3b336d93f22d16a824b8fef71ebe5fa16ec2ef2.png[/img]
Construction time may differ depending on a road segment's circumstances and costs. Some may take hours, while others can take days.
Finishing construction of a road will grant you Clout and improve your relations with city faction leaders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/7ada76b6b34f7ab44f836e3eaf01f2ac5b39d5ad.png[/img]

The appearance of roads will differ when passing over different terrain types.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/ad4973fb0748d6757e3a5c48b74f51f2afe7fb24.png[/img]
Your truck will travel more quickly over roads. They make passing over swamps and rivers more convenient, and also allow you to travel across impassible areas such as mountains.

[h2]Other Questions[/h2]
Q: Will the DLC work with my old save?
A: Yes, Road Builder DLC works with existing saves. Enter any Road Builder building to begin road construction.

We hope you enjoy this new feature! Please feel free to share any feedback or suggestions on our Steam forum, or join our [url=https://discord.gg/M68K7fcxNf]official Discord[/url].

[h2]v1.20.823 Update[/h2]
We've made a number of additions to version 1.20.823:
1. New "Negotiator" Mechanic
When trading goods in a city, you can choose a member of your crew to act as negotiator and try to upsell or haggle. The negotiator's success depends on the character's Speech, the crew's attributes, and your relations with the faction you are trading with. Even if the negotiation fails, the character's Speech will be increased.
2. New Hotkeys: You can now quickly close certain windows by pressing Escape.
3. New Recipes: You can now create 200+ more recipes by combining different ingredients.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/b92ff71e22410ee3a1e8831fe7fedd67b755bd31.jpg[/img]

As always, thank you for supporting Dustland Delivery!

notes.title: Dustland Delivery v1.20.645 Update (Fishing System Redesign)
notes.content:
Hello Dustlanders!
With the newest update, we have redesigned the existing fishing system.

[h3][u][b]Entering the Fishing System[/b][/u][/h3]
When your truck is located near a river, you can choose either [Fish] or [Quick Catch].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/3ceba87ee944f469ffaddd6908d2c803239f5481.png[/img]
Choosing [Quick Catch] will advance time, add to your Crew's Fatigue, and grant you fish depending on your Crew Fishing stat.
Choosing [Fish] will enter the new fishing system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/66ef1c5836d9ef933da63fc18a028852c3c09640.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u][/h3]

[b]Casting/Retrieving Your Line[/b]
Click [Cast Line] to start fishing. After a moment's wait, you may be able to hook a fish. You can also choose [Put Away Rod] to stop fishing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/bfe659b10cf61e75fed1abbbe070a1279bbedfea.png[/img]

[b]Catching Fish[/b]
After a moment's wait, you may be able to hook a fish, shrimp, or other aquatic creature. You might also unwittingly dredge up a piece of trash.
Once you've hooked a fish, it will begin to struggle. This is expressed through the "Struggle" and "Strength" bars.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/168b2d499c9a2f2231d3533beedd23dd503e2845.png[/img]
Different fish have different Strength values, and the Struggle meter will fill up gradually over time. Once the Struggle meter reaches the maximum, the fish will try to escape your lure, depending on its current Strength.
Of course, the rivers of the Dustlands are home to many other strange things too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/f8e2df481de2e4adbda8c3a3e6ec4546d7aa5add.png[/img]
If you hook a piece of trash, it won't struggle. But as it will be heavier than a fish, it will move by a shorter distance when you try to reel it in.

[b]Reeling in Your Catch[/b]
Clicking [Reel In] will have the following effects:
  a. Your lure will move toward your rod (i.e. to the left).
  b. Any items you hook will move toward your rod (but by a shorter distance than the lure).
Each time you click [Reel In], your lure will move toward you by a small distance, as will any item you may have hooked, depending on its attributes. If the distance between your lure and the item you hooked exceeds a certain value, the line will snap, and your catch will escape.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/0cbf738603de6727088de2474d90afb81409a0e4.png[/img]
If you have hooked a fish, its Strength meter will be reduced each time you reel it in. When its Strength reaches 0, it will stop struggling for a moment until its Strength recovers again. Each time a fish's Strength is exhausted, this will reduce the maximum limit of the Struggle meter. In other words, the more times you exhaust a fish's Strength, the weaker it becomes.

[b]Stamina[/b]
A character's Stamina is determined by their Fitness stat. Fishing costs Stamina. Once a character has exhausted their Stamina, they can no longer continue fishing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/12c29a74811545bb1bf269b363ea2a420c792cad.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]Results and Rewards[/b][/u][/h3]

[b]Success[/b]
If you can successfully pull your lure to the left hand side of the progress bar without your line snapping, you will retrieve your catch.
If you hooked a live animal, you will receive it as a reward.
If you hooked trash, you will receive materials such as Pig Iron or Leather.

[b]Failure[/b]
If the distance between your lure and the fish becomes too large and causes your line to snap, or the fish reaches the right hand side of the meter, you will fail. The character who is currently fishing will receive an increase to their Fishing stat.

[b]Results[/b]
Whether you succeed or fail, all characters who take part in fishing reduce their Stress and increase their Fatigue according to how much Stamina they consume.
If a character takes part in fishing but does not consume any Stamina, then their Stress and Fatigue will stay the same.

We've also made the following changes:
1. Added the ability to drop all Inedible Food at once.
2. Fixed display errors in the main interface.

Thanks once again for your support!

notes.title: Dustland Delivery v1.20.583 Update (Redesigned Hunting System)
notes.content:
Hello, Dustlanders! Please see below for notes on this week's update:

[b]◈ Update Version[/b]
v1.20.583

[b]◈ Update Details[/b]
[b]1. Redesigned the hunting system.[/b]
With the newest update, we have redesigned the existing hunting system.
When you stop your truck in the forest, you can search for animal tracks, which have a chance to give you a hunting task.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/cb55c50a87dbb26e5ec5b9e2b2034d2b470f94b9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/aca41811ce3b3c3407807c81d3f2098ffb918730.png[/img]
When you reach the location indicated by the task, the hunt is on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/c7491046cc430bdb9faef1fffde23def40338bad.png[/img]
When hunting, you must use a variety of actions to get closer to your prey without alerting them in order to increase your chances of success. Finally, when the time is right, you can capture your prey and complete the hunting task.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/f8e770478c0862074395dc186d8c5cc97d5d336a.png[/img]
Distance will affect the success rate of hunting; the closer the distance, the higher the probability of a successful hunt.
When their alertness reaches the maximum limit, your prey will flee, and you will fail the hunting task.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/6cc57c348acfbadd03321665c4836fd8b0f0e164.png[/img]
Different actions have different chances of success and different effects on your prey's alertness and distance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/782becbd183e49a74c1c76e6ab41f5d77bc3d3e5.png[/img]
Chances of success are determined by your Crew Hunting, Fitness, and Focus attributes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994478/2926a07e5d544c6eab252d2617ff68776acad2bf.png[/img]
A successful hunt will bag you different prey depending on the area. A failed hunt will also increase your Crew Hunting attribute. Whether you succeed or fail, going hunting will reduce your crew's Stress.
Please note that while you spend time hunting, the Infection and Risk meters will gradually build. If you spend too long, your crew might end up coming under attack from infected.

[b]Fixes[/b]
1. Fixed an issue where achievements would be displayed repeatedly in certain circumstances.
2. Fixed an issue where certain notification windows would be erroneously displayed in Chinese.
3. Fixed an issue where the Reinforced Axle would erroneously reduce Speed in certain circumstances.
4. Fixed a text display issue when buying or selling goods from caravans visiting player-owned cities.
5. Fixed issue where text would exceed text box limits in the combat screen.

[b]Improvements[/b]
1. Improved trait point notification display timing.
2. Improved notifications when truck Hull is low.

One more thing: the Dustland Delivery Steam Workshop beta test has begun! See the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2943280/eventcomments/4427687523462642473]official announcement[/url] for further details on how to take part.
We're hoping to make Steam Workshop support available as soon as possible. We're also planning to host a mod creation contest event, so stay tuned for further details!

Happy gaming!
